summary: The change raises the payments privileged idle timeout from 15 to 16 minutes, directly violating the parametric bound in SES-1 (<= 15). Although the change description references exception EXC-0233, that exception is scoped to the 'mortgage.session' component, not the 'payments.policy' or 'payments.controls-data' components actually modified, so it does not satisfy EXC-1's same-obligation-and-same-component requirement. The only payments-scoped session exception (EXC-0141) expired on 2026-09-09, well before the 2026-10-09 review time. All process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-6) are satisfied, but the product-obligation violation with no valid exception forces a REJECT.
